race.comment: Wide-open affair here - genuinely every horse could win without surprising. STEPARTY (11) looks the best suited, dropping 3.5kg off a strong return in the Listed Weekend Hussler behind PERSIAN SPIRIT. He goes well at this track and trip and with any luck from the gate will go close. HUGHES (10) ran on well first up when finishing behind the pair of PRIVATE EYE (2). HUGHES meets him much better off here and should strip fitter. PRIVATE EYE will run another honest race. PERSIAN SPIRIT (12) won well enough last time and sets up well again. WARNIE (5) comes through the better formlines, fourth in the G1 Toorak Handicap last time but barrier one will take some navigating. KING ZEPHYR (18) sneaks a run after scratchings and comes right into it off an excellent return.
